get.description: Liveness check: the process is up and serving requests.

post.description:
Sign in with email and password.

The access token is returned in the body; the refresh token is set as an
httpOnly cookie.
Swap the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new cookie.
End the login session; always succeeds.
Get an access token bound to another merchant you belong to.

get.description:
Who is signed in, for which merchant, and what they may do.

The portal uses this to draw only what the person can use. The server
still checks every request itself.

post.description:
The old address is retired for good, so no one else can take it and
old links never open another business.

Takes the outlet off the public page and off every team member's
outlet list. There is no delete: orders will point at outlets.

Brings it back private. Team members who lost it must be given it
again.

Invite someone. The response carries the token once; the portal builds
the link from it (an email is sent too once TASK-110 lands).

Public. Attempts are limited per address and per token, the same way
as login, because an existing user proves themselves with a password.

get.description:
Public. Shows the accept page what it needs. Limited like accepting,
and an invalid token counts as a failure, so tokens cannot be guessed.

put.description: Send every active category once, in the order to show them.

schema.title: Response Reorder Categories Categories Order Put

post.description:
Hides the category everywhere. Its products and its outlet settings
are kept, so restoring brings it back as it was.

put.description:
Send every active product of the category once, in the order to
show them.

post.description: There is no delete: orders will point at products.

put.description:
Replace the option groups the product uses, in the order to show
them, with optional per-product minimum and maximum.
Set the stock state at one outlet.

post.description: Add or remove units of a tracked product, atomically.

get.description: History of stock changes, newest first.

post.description: Reserve an import and get the address to send the CSV to.
Tell the API the file was sent; the check runs in the background.
Save a file that passed the check. Everything is saved or nothing.
Start generating the catalog CSV; poll the job for the download.

schema.title: Response List Groups Option Groups Get

put.description: Send every active group once, in the order to show them.

schema.title: Response Reorder Groups Option Groups Order Put

post.description:
Hides the group from its products. The links are kept, so restoring
brings it back as it was.

put.description: Send every active option of the group once, in the order to show.
Switch the option on or off at one outlet.

get.description:
Orders, newest first. Repeat ``status`` to keep several statuses;
``dateFrom`` and ``dateTo`` are days at the outlet, and with
``openAnyDate`` they only limit completed and cancelled orders; ``q``
is an order number, the start of a public code, part of the customer's
name, or (with ``view_customer_phone``) part of the phone.

post.description: Place an order on behalf of a customer (phone order, test).

get.description:
The tab counts: orders per status for the same filters as the list,
ignoring its ``status`` filter.

post.description: A one-use ticket (30 seconds) to open the event stream.

get.description:
Server-sent events for the live orders board.

Reconnect with a new ticket and ``after`` set to the last event id seen.

The same events as the stream, for screens that cannot use it.

Without ``after`` this only returns the current cursor.

AdjustBody.title: AdjustBody
AdjustBody.description: Add or remove units of a tracked product.

CategoryUpdate.title: CategoryUpdate
CategoryUpdate.description: Send only the fields to change. Description and image may be null.

IdList.title: IdList
IdList.description: Ids in the order they should appear, without repeats.

LegalUpdate.title: LegalUpdate
LegalUpdate.description: Send only the fields to change; null clears a field.

MemberUpdate.title: MemberUpdate
MemberUpdate.description:
Send only what changes. ``outletIds`` limits the member to those
outlets (and so turns ``allOutlets`` off); ``allOutlets: true`` lifts any
limit. Sending both ``outletIds`` and ``allOutlets: true`` is refused.

OptionGroupUpdate.title: OptionGroupUpdate
OptionGroupUpdate.description: Send only the fields to change.

OptionUpdate.title: OptionUpdate
OptionUpdate.description: Send only the fields to change.

OrderCountsOut.title: OrderCountsOut
OrderCountsOut.description:
How many orders are in each status for the same filters as the list
(the status filter itself is ignored).

OrderHistoryOut.title: OrderHistoryOut
OrderHistoryOut.description: One step of the status timeline.

OrderIn.title: OrderIn
OrderIn.description: An order entered by staff (a phone order, or a test).

OrderSummaryOut.title: OrderSummaryOut
OrderSummaryOut.description: One row of the orders list; the full order is ``GET /orders/{id}``.

OutletUpdate.title: OutletUpdate
OutletUpdate.description:
Send only what changes. Optional text and the map pin may be null to
clear. A new outlet starts private; ``isPublic`` is how it goes live.

ProductGroupLinks.title: ProductGroupLinks
ProductGroupLinks.description: The product's option groups, in the order to show them.

ProductOptionGroupOut.title: ProductOptionGroupOut
ProductOptionGroupOut.description:
A group as one product uses it. Min and max already include the
product's overrides.

ProductUpdate.title: ProductUpdate
ProductUpdate.description:
Send only the fields to change. Description, image, SKU and prep time
may be null.

SettingsUpdate.title: SettingsUpdate
SettingsUpdate.description: Send only the fields to change. Text fields may be null to clear.

StockBody.title: StockBody
StockBody.description:
The whole stock state of a product at one outlet. ``quantity`` is
required for ``tracked`` and not allowed otherwise. Send ``version`` (as
last read) to be refused when someone else changed it meanwhile.

TaxInfo.title: TaxInfo
TaxInfo.description: The tax in force for the merchant's country. Read-only.

TransitionBody.title: TransitionBody
TransitionBody.description:
Send ``version`` (as last read) to be refused when the order changed
meanwhile.

UploadTarget.title: UploadTarget
UploadTarget.description: Send the file to ``url`` with this method and these headers.
